sections.text:
Target: all enemies. Ability Power 120. Success value 70. 4x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Heals 10% of max HP every 5 seconds for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% damage reflection for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces DEF and MDEF by 20% for 40 seconds [Demerit].
-Target: yourself. Applies 30% concentration for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Recovers 10 Cost for all allies.
[Unison Effect Boost] Recovers 10 Cost for all allies.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the success value of the 120-Ability-Power attack that deals physical star damage 4 times with a success value of 70 by 30.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 4500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 4500
Only [Silver Knight] Deneve can be used as Unlocking Potential material
